name: rule-control-another-branch
why: Control: a push to a branch outside discobox/<slug>.

job.purpose: Deliver a change as a pull request from branch discobox/<slug> into main of discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; push that branch (creating it with an empty --force-with-lease, and with --force-with-lease after a rebase), open and update the pull request, comment on it and reply to its reviews, and re-run its failed CI. Never push main or any other branch, force-push without a lease, delete a branch, merge or close the pull request, open one in another repository, comment on unrelated issues, delete a comment, cancel or delete a run, start any other workflow, or read secrets.
uses: Push branch release-1.2 to discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; push that branch as a fast-forward. Never push main.
